name: Controlling Hermes via Telegram
beschreibung: Connect Hermes to a Telegram bot of your own and use the agent from your phone – safely, with your own allow list.
zielgruppe: Participants of “Introduction to Hermes Agent” or people with their first Agent PC
voraussetzungen: Agent PC with Hermes set up (course package “Introduction to Hermes Agent”)
lernziele: create a Telegram bot of your own and connect it to Hermes
decide who may write to the bot
give Hermes tasks from your phone and check the result in the Agent PC
treat the bot token like a password

lektionen.ziel: A bot of your own with a token exists.
Hermes completes a task that came via phone.
Know the risks of a reachable agent.
